name: btn: End Party Relation from Party
purpose: Ends a relation between two parties: sends both party ids to karbon_kontroller 'Edit Party Relation' with CurrentInd false and ThruDate today, then commits. Relies on the portal row being the current related record.
open_question: The rule 'ending a relation = current flag off + end date today' is written here in the client; kontroller only stores it.

name: btn: Add Related Person to Organization
purpose: Opens the create-party card to add a new person related to the current organization, passing the organization id and name and a flag that the organization is fixed.

name: btn: Add Related Organization to Person
purpose: Opens the create-party card to add a new organization related to the current person, passing the person id, first and last name and a flag that the person is fixed.

name: btn: Restore Party Relation from Party
purpose: Restores an ended relation between two parties: sends both party ids to karbon_kontroller 'Edit Party Relation' with CurrentInd true and an empty ThruDate, then commits. Relies on the portal row being the current related record.

name: btn: Delete PartyRelation
purpose: Deletes a party relation by id through karbon_kontroller 'Delete Party Relation' and shows an error dialog on failure.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: No caller found, not even a layout button; the portal delete may have been replaced by End Party Relation (script 423).
